access_auth_code_instructions.message: 인증 코드를 받으려면 계정을 만들고 {link}ur.io{/link}에 로그인하세요. 계정 -> 설정 -> 인증 코드 생성/복사 -> 붙여넣기 -> 완료!
access_auth_code_instructions.description: Instructions for accessing the authentication code. Use the {link}...{/link} markers to wrap the "ur.io" portion, which should be rendered as a clickable link. Example usage: - Web: Replace {link} with and {/link} with - SwiftUI: Use AttributedString parsing to detect {link}...{/link} and apply .link attribute to the range - Jetpack Compose: Use AnnotatedString with an annotation for the {link}...{/link} range, and handle clicks accordingly

auth_code_input_invalid.message: 인증 코드가 잘못되었거나 만료되었습니다. 유효한 인증 코드를 받으려면 ur.io에 로그인하세요.
auth_code_input_invalid.description: Invalid auth code input error message

authentication_code_input_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the authentication code input field

auth_code_input_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the authentication code input field

back.description: Button text for going back to the previous screen.

best_available_provider.description: VPN providers list option to select the best available provider

best_matches.description: Label for a list or section showing the best matching results.

cities.description: Provider list group title for cities

connect.description: Button text to connect to URnetwork VPN

countries.description: Provider list group title for countries

data_limit_reached.description: Alert title and status line on the connect screen, and the title of a local notification, when the server refuses a paying account's connection because a data limit was reached (a per-device data cap or the plan's data), not because the account has no balance. Short.

devices.description: Provider list group title for devices

disconnected.description: Connection status shown on the connect panel and in the tray tooltip when the tunnel is down. The counterpart of the `connected` key.

dont_see_it.description: Prompt shown when user doesn't see the verification email or SMS.

error_sending_password_reset_link.message: 비밀번호 재설정 링크를 보내는 중 오류가 발생했습니다
error_sending_password_reset_link.description: Shown when sending the password reset link fails (the request failed, or the server reports it could not send the link). Used on the password reset and account screens.

error_sending_verification_code.message: 인증 코드를 보내는 중 오류가 발생했습니다.
error_sending_verification_code.description: Inline error on the verify page when the verification code could not be sent (after sign-in, sign-up or resend). Matches the apple CreateNetworkVerifyView literal.

extension_buy_data.description: Browser extension popup, out-of-balance alert: a button that opens ur.io's data packs (ur.io/buy-data) in a new tab. Short.

extension_connect_failed.description: Browser extension popup, under the button: a connect failed and the server gave no reason of its own (when it gives one, the popup shows that instead).

extension_data_limit_disconnect_first.message: 데이터를 구매하려면 먼저 '연결 해제'를 선택하세요. 그 전에는 결제를 완료할 수 없습니다.
extension_data_limit_disconnect_first.description: Browser extension popup, out-of-balance alert for a Pro account at its plan's data, while the extension holds the browser's traffic: ur.io's data packs (the Buy data button) can't load through URnetwork until the user disconnects, and nothing disconnects for them. Disconnect is the button above this line; name it by its own label (the disconnect key). The free plan's counterpart is insufficient_balance_disconnect_first.

extension_ip_checking.description: Browser extension popup, the IP line at its top, while the popup asks which IP address the browser's requests leave from. IP is the IP address.

extension_ip_unavailable.description: Browser extension popup, the IP line at its top, when the check of which IP address the browser's requests leave from failed. Short.

extension_kill_switch_blocks_on_failure.description: Browser extension popup, subtitle under the Kill switch toggle while it is on: if the proxy fails, the browser's traffic stops instead of going out without URnetwork. Short.

extension_kill_switch_may_leak_on_failur.description: Browser extension popup, subtitle under the Kill switch toggle while it is off (its default): if the proxy fails, the browser's traffic can go out without URnetwork. Short.

extension_location_unchanged.message: 브라우저는 여전히 이전 위치에 연결되어 있습니다.
extension_location_unchanged.description: Browser extension popup, under the reason a location change failed: the change did not happen, and the browser stays connected through the proxy and the location it had before.

extension_out_of_data_alerts_note.description: Browser extension popup, under the settings toggles, beside the Turn on alerts button (extension_turn_on_alerts): what the alerts are. Once the user allows it, the browser shows one notification when the account's data runs out, also while the popup is closed.

extension_out_of_data_held.message: 데이터를 사용할 수 있게 되거나 연결을 해제할 때까지 이 브라우저에서 페이지가 로드되지 않습니다.
extension_out_of_data_held.description: Browser extension popup, out-of-balance alert, and the body of the browser notification for it: the account has no data left, and the extension keeps its proxy set whatever the kill switch says, so pages fail rather than load without URnetwork, until the free refresh, an upgrade or a data pack makes data available, or the user presses Disconnect. The ur.io counterpart is site_out_of_data_browser_held, without its kill switch clause.

extension_proxy_active_network_unreachab.message: 프록시가 활성화되었지만 네트워크에 연결할 수 없습니다.
extension_proxy_active_network_unreachab.description: Browser extension popup, note under the button: the browser is set to the extension's proxy, but the popup's own IP check found three times running that requests do not leave through URnetwork.

extension_proxy_fell_back.message: 프록시가 응답하지 않아 확장 프로그램이 프록시를 껐습니다. 다시 연결할 때까지 이 브라우저는 URnetwork 없이 연결됩니다.
extension_proxy_fell_back.description: Browser extension popup, under the Connect button (status Disconnected): the proxy failed three health checks in a row with the kill switch off, so the extension took its proxy setting off, and the browser went back to its own connection (direct, or the proxy its own settings name). Keep URnetwork as is.

extension_proxy_other_extension.message: 다른 확장 프로그램이 이 브라우저의 프록시 설정을 제어하고 있어 URnetwork가 연결할 수 없습니다. URnetwork를 사용하려면 해당 확장 프로그램을 끄세요.
extension_proxy_other_extension.description: Browser extension popup, under the button while the status line reads Another extension controls the proxy (extension_status_other_extension). Turning the other extension off is done in the browser's extension settings. Keep URnetwork as is.

extension_proxy_policy.message: 이 브라우저의 프록시 설정은 정책으로 관리되므로 URnetwork가 연결할 수 없습니다.
extension_proxy_policy.description: Browser extension popup, under the button while the status line reads Proxy managed by policy (extension_status_proxy_policy). Keep URnetwork as is.

extension_proxy_unreachable_kill_switch.message: 프록시가 응답하지 않습니다. 프록시가 응답할 때까지 킬 스위치가 브라우저를 오프라인 상태로 유지합니다.
extension_proxy_unreachable_kill_switch.description: Browser extension popup, under the Disconnect button while the status line reads Proxy not answering (extension_status_proxy_not_answering): why pages don't load. Translate kill switch as the kill_switch key does.

extension_setting_not_saved.message: 설정을 저장하지 못해 변경되지 않았습니다. 다시 시도하세요.
extension_setting_not_saved.description: Browser extension popup, under the Kill switch or the location sync toggle when saving a change failed: the toggle went back to its previous state.

extension_status_other_extension.message: 다른 확장 프로그램이 프록시를 제어 중
extension_status_other_extension.description: Browser extension popup, status line at its foot: another browser extension holds the browser's proxy setting, and the browser gives it priority over URnetwork, so URnetwork is not connected. Short.

extension_status_proxy_not_answering.description: Browser extension popup, status line at its foot: the kill switch keeps the extension's proxy set although the proxy failed three health checks in a row, so this browser is offline until the proxy answers or the user disconnects. Short.

extension_status_proxy_policy.description: Browser extension popup, status line at its foot: the browser's proxy settings are fixed by policy (set by an administrator or an organization), so no extension can set them and URnetwork is not connected. Short; use the word the browser itself uses for its managed settings in the language.

extension_turn_on_alerts.description: Browser extension popup: a small button, shown while the browser has not let the extension show notifications, that asks the browser for that permission. With it, the extension shows one browser notification when the account runs out of data; without it, the popup's alert and a ! on the toolbar icon show it. It sits under the settings toggles beside extension_out_of_data_alerts_note, and in the out-of-data alert beside Get Pro and Buy data. Short.

get_started.description: Button text for beginning the login or create network process used on the Initial Auth screen.

insufficient_balance.description: Shown on the Connect screen when the account's data balance has run out: a balance of data, not of money.

insufficient_balance_disconnect_first.message: 업그레이드하려면 먼저 '연결 해제'를 선택하세요. 그 전에는 결제를 완료할 수 없습니다.
insufficient_balance_disconnect_first.description: Out-of-balance alert, on the desktop builds whose checkout has to go through the tunnel (Windows, Linux), while the tunnel holds or blocks traffic. Their Disconnect lifts the kill switch too; apple and android say more (insufficient_balance_disconnect_first_kill_switch). Payment cannot reach the store until the user disconnects, and nothing disconnects for them; Disconnect is the button beside this line. Each translation names that button by its own label (the disconnect key).

insufficient_balance_refreshes_in.description: Leads the out-of-balance notice (and the Upgrade screen when a blocked connect opened it): when the free daily data is granted again. {time} is the time left until the next 00:00 UTC as a compact duration (e.g. 5h 12m).

its_nice_to_see_you_again.description: Greeting text on Enter user auth password screen.

join_urnetwork.description: Join URnetwork title on the Create Network screen

launch.description: Button text for entering the one-time authentication code and entering the app

licenses.description: Settings row and screen title: the open source licenses and data attributions the app includes

licenses_data_header.description: Licenses screen: section header for the data sources (IP location, blocklists, maps)

licenses_intro.message: URnetwork는 아래의 오픈 소스 소프트웨어와 데이터로 만들어졌습니다. 각 항목에는 해당 라이선스와 필요한 고지가 표시됩니다.
licenses_intro.description: Licenses screen: the paragraph above the list

licenses_project_page.description: Licenses detail: link to the component's project home page

licenses_software_header.description: Licenses screen: section header for the open source libraries and fonts

mock_location_active.description: Status shown while the device location is being synced with a provider. The argument is the provider's city or country.

mock_location_disclosure_browser_only.message: 변경된 위치는 이 브라우저의 페이지에만 표시됩니다. 기기의 위치는 그대로입니다.
mock_location_disclosure_browser_only.description: Disclosure shown with the browser geolocation override toggle: the simulated location is reported only to pages in this browser, not to the device.

mock_location_disclosure_sites_can_detec.message: 사이트는 위치가 모의 위치임을 감지할 수 있으며 작동을 거부할 수 있습니다.
mock_location_disclosure_sites_can_detec.description: Disclosure shown with the browser geolocation override toggle: sites can detect a simulated location and may refuse to work.

mock_location_waiting_for_provider.description: Status shown while the mock location feature waits for a connected provider's location to become known.

network_name_label.description: Label for the network name input field

network_name_input_label.description: Label for the network name input field

network_name_length_error.description: Hint text indicating the required length for a network name input.

network_name_input_hint.description: Hint text indicating the required length for a network name input.

network_name_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the network name input field.

network_name_input_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the network name input field.

network_name_taken.message: 이 네트워크 이름은 이미 사용 중입니다
network_name_taken.description: Error for network name input to display when a network name is already taken.

password_label.description: Label for the password input field.

password.description: Label for the password input field.

password_support_txt.description: Hint for password input length requirements.

password_input_length_hint.description: Hint for password input length requirements.

plan_account_name.description: Shown with the plan (Free or Pro) on the Account screen, the plan card and the subscription screen, and in the purchase confirmation: the account (network) the plan belongs to. The argument is the signed-in network's own name. Customers with several accounts could not tell which one held Pro (support inbox 6546).

promoted.description: VPN providers list option for promoted providers

provider_connected_duration_hours.description: Compact duration a provider has been connected, as hours and minutes (e.g. 3h 24m). {hours} is the whole hours, {minutes} the remaining minutes.

provider_connected_duration_minutes.description: Compact duration a provider has been connected, as minutes (e.g. 24m).

regions.description: Provider list group title for regions

resend_verify_code.description: Button text to resend the verification code

resend_code.description: Button text to resend the verification code

reset_link_rate_limited.message: 시도 횟수가 너무 많습니다. {minutes}분 후에 새 재설정 링크를 요청할 수 있습니다.
reset_link_rate_limited.description: Password reset: the server refused to send a new password reset link because of too many recent attempts. The argument is the number of minutes until a new link can be requested.

site_app_connecting.description: App connect screen and macOS menu bar: status while a connect is in progress, before the connection is up.

site_data_limit_pro.message: 이번 주기의 Pro 데이터를 모두 사용했습니다. 무료 일일 데이터는 계속 매일 00:00 UTC에 제공되고, Pro 데이터는 다음 구독 주기가 시작될 때 갱신되며, 데이터 팩으로 지금 더 추가할 수 있습니다.
site_data_limit_pro.description: ur.io Connect screen and the browser extension popup: out-of-balance notice for a Pro account whose plan data is used up (title: Data limit reached). Pro's 10 TiB is granted at the start of each of the network's own subscription cycles, not on a fixed day of the month. Every account, Pro included, also gets the free daily data at 00:00 UTC, which a Pro account uses once its plan data is used up. A data pack (sold on ur.io, the Buy data button beside this line) adds data at once. Keep Pro and 00:00 UTC as is.

stay_completely_private_and_anonymous.description: Used as a headline in the Initial Auth carousel.

sync_device_location_with_provider.description: Toggle that makes the device (or browser, on the extension) report a connected provider's location instead of the real location. The provider used is the most stable (longest-connected) one.

terms_checkbox.description: Label for the terms and conditions acceptance checkbox. It should read like "I agree to URnetwork's Terms and Services and Privacy Policy" The {terms_start} and {terms_end} markers wrap the "Terms and Services" text. The {privacy_start} and {privacy_end} markers wrap the "Privacy Policy" text. Platform-specific rendering: - Web: Replace {terms_start} with , {terms_end} with , etc. - iOS: Use these markers to identify ranges for NSAttributedString link attributes - Android: Use these markers to identify ranges for ClickableSpan

use_most_stable_provider.description: Note under the location sync toggle explaining that the most stable (longest-connected) provider's location is used. Doubles as the resting status when no more specific status applies.

user_auth_input_label.description: Label for the user authentication input field.

user_auth_input_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the user authentication input field.

verify_code_rate_limited.message: 시도 횟수가 너무 많습니다. {minutes}분 후에 새 코드를 요청할 수 있습니다.
verify_code_rate_limited.description: Verify screen: the server refused to send a new verification code because of too many recent attempts. The argument is the number of minutes until a new code can be requested.

verify_explanation.message: 실제 신원을 알려주세요. 본인 확인을 위해 보내드린 코드를 입력해주세요.
verify_explanation.description: Sub header text explaining why verification is needed.

verify_input_invalid.description: Error message shown when the verification code input is invalid.

verify_input_label.description: Label for the verification code input field
